space: ship-local GLB-NATIVE coordinates; crew are parented to the ship GLB root (which the client yaws −90° via baseYawDeg). Author in the GLB's OWN frame so crew sit on the deck regardless of that yaw.

axes.note: DIFFERENT from the brig/sloop (which are bow=+Z). The merchantman GLB exports bow=+X; beam_axis below tells the crew code the rail axis is Z.

heading_convention: yaw deg about +Y (Babylon local): 0 = facing +Z (starboard), 90 = facing +X (BOW), 180 = facing -Z (port), 270 = facing -X (stern). Gun crews face outboard; the helm faces the bow.

landmarks.note: Fore+main square-rigged on the gun deck (y5.3); the mizzen + wheel are on the raised quarterdeck aft (x<-5, y6.7). Six guns a side at x≈4.1/-2.4/-5.9 (from the B_Lid bones), rails at z≈±3.4.

edges.note: ramp up to the raised quarterdeck

stations.note: abaft the ship's wheel (hub root-local -7,7.96,0), ~0.3m behind it on the quarterdeck, facing the bow — hands IK onto the wheel rim
abaft the starboard fwd gun (breech z~1.5), facing the port/outboard — hands IK onto the barrel
abaft the starboard mid gun, hands on the barrel
abaft the port fwd gun, hands on the barrel
abaft the port mid gun, hands on the barrel
at the foremast fife rail (port side), FACING the rail (inboard +Z) — hands IK onto the pins
at the mainmast fife rail (stbd side), facing the rail (inboard -Z) — hands on the pins
at the mizzen fife rail (stbd side), facing the rail (inboard -Z) — hands on the pins

notes: Authored in the GLB-native frame (bow=+X, beam=Z) because crew parent to the yawed model root; beam_axis='z' tells the crew code the rail axis. Heights (gun_deck 5.3, quarterdeck 6.7) + station positions are derived from the B_Mast / B_Lid / B_Wheel bones and deck bounds — LIVE-TUNE if crew float or clip.
6 guns/side, helm on the quarterdeck, fife-rail + capstan + lookout work stations. No ladders (the quarterdeck is reached by a walk ramp) so no climb_paths.
